title: Lab evaluation of the 60 estimators and their linear combination: leave-one-group-out RMSE, incremental value, MTMM and the Track B weight fit
intent: Freeze the spec 3.2-3.3 lab evaluation, define exactly what bias60-external-lab-build must deliver for it to be computable, and refuse to publish a single lab number unless every rail holds. When the lab is absent the report says so with nulls; it never substitutes a plausible figure.

sections.track_b_fitting: ### 3.2 Fitting linear weights on the lab (Track B)
sections.track_a: ### 3.4 Two-track structure and the rule-clean fallback (Track A)

spec.two_level_design: component-level weights on lab component labels, then a 3-weight composite layer on lab composite labels, so the parameter count is about 60 + 3 rather than 60 x 3

operator_decision.decided_by: operator, recorded by the shared steward in orchestrator commit 901d5e3c8ee89eb9995e2adb15a3fee6c48b49ee
operator_decision.effect_on_this_row: the organiser-ruling precondition is replaced: lab-fitted weights may be used, but only the learned weight vector and its normalisation constants cross, recorded with SHA-256 and the lab commit, and the lab method must be disclosed in the writeup
still_binding: no reference layer or equivalent copy is computed on, joined to, or used to approximate targets for any study-region tract or GEOID
only the weight vector and normalisation constants cross
disclose the lab method in the writeup

artifact_contract.note: the evaluator reads nothing else; a lab that carries extra columns fails rather than being silently accepted

exclusion.note: every lab tract must record nearest_study_tract_km at or beyond the buffer, so the exclusion is auditable after the fact rather than asserted by the build

weights.shrinkage_target: equal weights within the scored set

acceptance.note: Track B either beats equal weights in at least 75% of held-out groups or is reported as not beating; reporting the loss is a pass, inventing the win is not

track_a_preregistration.release_gate: while no Track A pre-registration record exists, weight_vector_release stays withheld: the lab numbers may be computed and reported for the writeup, but no weight vector is released to a candidate

forbidden_fields: any value keyed to a study tract

study_side.note: this evaluator scores lab rows only; study-side emissions belong to the Track A and final-candidate rows, and reading the study idea parquets here would be the first step toward applying lab weights to study tracts

negative_controls.mutation: add an official scored GEOID to the lab tract table
record a nearest-study-tract distance inside the buffer
claim the road-ratio self-check passed with a ratio outside the frozen band
give an undefined estimator row a non-zero value
drop the SHA-256 from one registered source
remove tracts until fewer than five groups remain
allow a lab per-tract value into the crossing surface
publish an RMSE while the lab artifacts are absent
emit a study-side prediction from lab-fitted weights
release the weight vector before the Track A pre-registration exists
point the evaluation at a different spec hash
report the shift-corrected variant as measured with no study-feature allowlist
evaluate as if the prerequisite probe had never been run
drop the disclosed group shortfalls from the consumed probe

recipe.source: RULES.md published statistics, frozen in config/bias60-lab-preregistered.json

prerequisite_probe.note: the probe measures the two things the build cannot fake: whether the planned lab groups still hold tracts after the frozen exclusion on real census geography, and whether each registered source answers an anonymous request at its registered pattern. An evaluation without it is incomplete, so a gate fails
